sloka: एतच्छुत्वा ततो वाक्यं रावणस्य मुखोद्गतम् ।सहसा भीमनिर्घोषमुद्घुष्टं रजनीचरैः ।। ६.४२.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: etacchutvā tato vākyaṁ rāvaṇasya mukhodgatam ।sahasā bhīmanirghoṣamudghuṣṭaṁ rajanīcaraiḥ ।। 6.42.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the command issued from Ravana's mouth, immediately a terrific roar was raised by the night rangers.
